title: (No AI) Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved prestigious Millennium Prize problem with Claude
author: Robert Hart
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/11/gettyimages-2305894185.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Anthropic went public on November 19th, 2026. | Photo: Getty Images

Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claims he has solved the Riemann hypothesis, one of mathematics' most notoriously difficult problems, with the help of Claude, cracking a puzzle that has eluded some of the world's best mathematicians for decades. If verified, it would mark yet another seismic achievement for AI in mathematics, and add to the [upheaval already unleashed by OpenAI's previous, often inelegant forays](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1004933/ai-math-openai-breakthrough-solution) into the field.

Alpöge's solution has yet to be verified independently. Anthropic has not commented or involved itself in Alpöge's announcement. In [a document on his website](https://alpo.ge/remark.pdf), Alpöge says he texted Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei abo …

title: (No AI) The week everything fell apart
author: David Pierce
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/11/VRG_VST_111926_Site.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

There was a [dayslong Outlook outage](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1035364/microsoft-outlook-outage-notepad). A [nationwide ground stop](https://www.theverge.com/transportation/1034039/faa-aviation-glitch-meltdown-ground-stop) for only the second time in 25 years. Banks [seemed to suddenly stop working](https://www.theverge.com/news/1034952/chase-bank-outage-down-bank-of-america-wells-fargo-zelle). Even iCloud [couldn't stay up and running](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1035826/some-apple-services-are-down). This week, it felt like the technological world simply collapsed. And it felt like this might be the beginning of something even bigger.

On [this episode of _The Vergecast_](https://pod.link/vergecast), Nilay and David go through the week's many calamities, and try to explain both what happened in each case - which was generally much milder than the conspiracy theories would have you believe - and why all these small issues might still add up to something worth worrying about.
